item.title: What a Canadian salary guide says once the tables are read correctly
item.description:
The Salary project set out to answer a simple question: how is a given job paid from one Canadian region to another? It extracts recruitment-firm salary guides from PDF, puts them in data frames and compares them in notebooks. The notebooks already contain charts. Several of them are wrong, and the reasons are more instructive than the charts themselves.

This article re-reads the 2023 guide from the text the repository already extracted, fixes what went wrong, and reports what the guide actually says.
